title: Learning to Swim at Twenty
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: I learned to swim when I was twenty, and I was embarrassed about **it** for
years. As a child, I had a bad experience at a crowded pool and was too
afraid to try again. My friends often invited me to the beach, but I
always made excuses. When **they** went into the water, I stayed on the
In my second year at university, I saw a poster for free adult swimming
lessons. I almost walked past it. Then I thought about how much I was
missing. On the first day, I was the oldest person in the class, and the
instructor, a woman in her sixties, noticed my fear immediately. **She**
did not push me. For the first week, we only practiced breathing with our
faces in the water. **This** seemed silly at first, but it helped me relax.
